_notes.allowed_catalogs: Optional allowlist of catalogs users may browse. Empty = every catalog the app service principal can see (minus hidden_catalogs).
_notes.default_catalog: Optional catalog pre-selected on load. Empty = user picks.
_notes.workflow_catalog / workflow_schema: Where the app's own tables (glossary_proposals, data_stewards) live. This is independent of the catalogs being governed. The app SP needs CREATE/MODIFY here.
_notes.roles.demo_mode: When true, every authenticated user gets all roles so one viewer can exercise the full workflow. Set false and populate governance_leads / step2_approvers for a real deployment.
_notes.uc_writeback.enabled: When true, a fully approved proposal writes the definition as a column COMMENT and (optionally) a 'sensitivity' TAG back to the governed table. The app SP needs MODIFY + APPLY TAG on that table.
_notes.env_overrides: GLOSSARY_ENVIRONMENT, GLOSSARY_DEFAULT_CATALOG, AI_MODEL_ENDPOINT, GLOSSARY_CONFIG_PATH override the matching values at runtime.
